report.title: Unit disappears when entering payload conveyor
report.body:
### Platforms

Windows

### Build

27713

### Issue

Unit disappears when entering payload conveyor

### Steps to reproduce

Using RTS or manually control a unit entering a payload conveyor.

### Mods used

none

### Save file

Any save

### (Crash) logs

_No response_

summary: Could not reproduce or disprove the reported disappearance because the required unit-entry transition was not achieved. A vanilla sandbox world was launched, the Units build category was opened, and a Payload Conveyor was selected and placed (its visible tooltip and conveyor sprite confirmed it). Attempts to create a Ground Factory test source produced only unconstructed placement ghosts because the setup lacked delivery/construction capability, and no existing controllable ground unit was available. Thus no unit entered the conveyor.

spec.summary: Reported unit disappearance when it enters a payload conveyor in Mindustry build 27713 on Windows.
spec.bug_class: entity visibility/removal or payload-conveyor interaction (reported symptom only)
spec.observed_behavior: The reporter states that a unit disappears when entering a payload conveyor.
spec.expected_behavior: A unit entering a payload conveyor should remain present and be transported/handled according to normal payload conveyor behavior.
known_preconditions: Reporter states no mods were used.
The report says the issue can occur while using RTS control or manual unit control.
A payload conveyor and a unit capable of entering it are involved.
uncertain_conditions: Whether the unit is actually removed, becomes invisible, is stored as a payload, is moved elsewhere, or is only no longer controllable.
Whether the behavior occurs for every unit type or only particular units.
Whether the behavior requires RTS control, manual control, or occurs in both modes.
Whether the behavior occurs on every map/save; "Any save" is reporter-provided and not independently verified.
Whether the reported Windows build corresponds exactly to the supplied target commit.
Whether the issue reproduces on Linux; Linux evaluation is planned but no result is provided.
Whether payload conveyor orientation, connections, power state, unit size, payload capacity, or nearby blocks affect the result.
Whether the unit is entering the conveyor through intended gameplay behavior versus an edge-case placement/control interaction.
Whether the report describes a regression and, if so, the last known working build.
reproduction_hints: On Windows build 27713, create or load a map containing a payload conveyor.
Use a unit and attempt to enter the payload conveyor while manually controlling the unit.
Repeat using RTS control if available.
Observe the unit before entry, while on the conveyor, and after it reaches any connected destination.
Compare behavior across unit types, conveyor orientations, and connected/unconnected payload conveyor setups.
Record whether the unit remains selectable, appears in a payload block, emerges at an output, or is absent from the map.
required_artifacts: Save file or minimal reproducible schematic/map showing the payload conveyor setup.
Video or screenshots covering unit approach, entry, conveyor transit, and expected exit/destination.
Game logs from a reproduction session, including client log and any console output.
Exact full game version/build identifier and confirmation of the commit-to-build mapping.
Reproduction frequency and whether it occurs in a new vanilla world.
Map name, game mode, and multiplayer/single-player status.
Payload conveyor configuration: orientation, adjacent blocks, destination block(s), power state, and whether the conveyor network is blocked.
Control method used for each reproduction attempt: manual control, RTS control, or both.
Any error messages, desync indicators, or unit selection/state observations after disappearance.
Linux evaluation results, if testing is performed.

hypotheses.statement: A controllable unit entering a payload conveyor is removed or becomes invisible instead of surviving transport.
hypotheses.prediction: In a vanilla sandbox setup, a unit visible before entry will no longer be visible/selectable after crossing into a payload conveyor, without emerging normally.
hypotheses.observation: A payload conveyor was placed and visibly confirmed in a sandbox world, but no controllable or produced ground unit could be obtained in the available session; therefore an entry event could not be performed.
